scope: Workflow UI response ordering; isolated temporary services and synthetic runtime data

failure_modes: old directory overwrote a saved workflow
old refresh overwrote a newer completed refresh
obsolete route published data after changing selection, page, or navigation generation
obsolete read failure escaped to its caller
old success replaced a newer mutation and cleared its refresh failure

workflow_sync_checks: Delayed directory response cannot undo an archived workflow after a successful current refresh
Delayed success cannot clear a newer refresh failure or undo its accepted archive
Delayed detail cannot undo cancellation; queued business node remains unstarted
Obsolete detail failure cannot overwrite a newly selected run or show its error
Both cancellation requests terminate their original records without creating node tasks
browser.capture: Wait for fonts and two animation frames, then capture full page

follow_up.note: The original queued-cancellation completion check used a promise-valued DOM predicate. The follow-up replaces it with explicit awaited API polling and verifies actual terminal states; use that follow-up as authoritative for completion checks.

limitations: HTTP reads are not a shared database transaction snapshot
Response generations are local to one page; later server updates are discovered by normal refresh
This verification does not rebuild or publish a release artifact
